goal: Phase 1 only — the DESIGN. The person gives a Civitai image link and wants a workflow that consistently makes images of that kind. The agent must read the image's own recipe (reference_recipe), recreate it faithfully — its model, its LoRA at its strength, its sampler settings and size, its prompt as the template — and present it on the approval card. It stops at the ask. Judged by reading the stage workflow against the image's embedded ComfyUI graph.

reference.source: Civitai image 27763004 — its embedded ComfyUI graph: UNETLoader flux_dev -> LoraLoaderModelOnly(RetroAnimeFlux\RetroAnimeFluxV1, 1.2) -> ModelSamplingFlux -> BasicGuider/SamplerCustomAdvanced; FluxGuidance 3.5, euler / sgm_uniform, 35 steps, 1024x1536
steps: one FLUX.1 dev text-to-image stage with the Retro Anime Flux LoRA (Civitai 806265, base Flux.1 D) at 1.2, 35 steps, euler / sgm_uniform, guidance 3.5, 1024x1536
must: the model is FLUX.1 dev (not Z-Image, Qwen, FLUX.2 or another usual pick)
the stage carries the RetroAnimeFlux LoRA (Civitai version 806265 with its url) at strength 1.2 — or Comfy Cloud's flux1-lora-retro_anime_style named as an unverified stand-in, said so
steps, sampler, scheduler, guidance and size follow the image's recipe
the prompt keeps the image's style wording; only the subject is made variable

turns.text: Make me a workflow that consistently creates images like this one: https://civitai.com/images/27763004 — same look every time, I'll change the character.
